name: novel-build
description: Execute a durable novel build by scheduling typed planning, drafting, canon, critique, revision, and checkpoint tasks.
procedure: Read the persisted build state and select only dependency-ready work.
Issue typed task contracts with explicit inputs, outputs, acceptance criteria, scope, model policy, budget, and retry policy.
Plan story state before prose: brief, narrative contract, characters, world, threads, acts, chapters, scenes, timeline, and setup/payoff map.
Draft chapters sequentially in causal order from compiler-built context packs.
After each draft, extract canon and state, run diagnostics, request an independent critique, and allow at most the task quality gate's revision count.
Checkpoint accepted work and continue until the build has no ready tasks or reaches a true blocker.
